messages:
nina: quick report: async client leaking JSON parse errors when server returns non-json error bodies (text/html or text/plain). users don't get http status or request id in the raised exception. repro below.

nina: async repro:
```py
async with AsyncClient(api_key) as c:
    try:
        await c.completions.create(prompt='hi')
    except Exception as e:
        print(type(e), getattr(e, 'status_code', None))
```

nina: failing response (faked):
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: text/html
X-Request-Id: r_99xyz

<html>bad request</html>

kai: which sdk version?

nina: 0.9.2 pinned. stack shows ValueError from resp.json() surface as top-level exception.

maria: agreed this is frustrating. SDK should never let a low-level JSONDecodeError be what callers catch. propose ApiError(Exception) public attrs: status_code, headers, raw_body, parsed (Optional), request_id. add into py.typed so mypy can see it.

kai: minimal patch: try parse json, except -> parsed=None; if status >=400: raise ApiError with status_code, headers, raw_body, parsed; set __cause__ to original parse error so debugging info is preserved.

nina: will add unit tests for sync+async stubbing text/html and text/plain responses and assert attrs. include migration note in docs showing safe handling:```py
try:
    await client.completions.create(...)
except ApiError as ae:
    logger.info(ae.status_code, ae.request_id, ae.raw_body[:200])
```

maria: also consider ApiError.to_dict() helper for easy structured logging. once PR is up ping @sdk-bot.

sdk-bot: CI queued for PR #510 (unit, lint, mypy).

nina: thanks, will open PR in ~30m with tests + typing + changelog.
